name: The Renaissance
description: The rebirth of classical learning and naturalistic art radiating from the Italian city-states: humanism, perspective, printing, and the patronage economics of Medici Florence — shading into the Scientific Revolution and the age of exploration.

name: Age of Exploration
description: Iberian navigators, driven by spices, gold, and faith and enabled by the caravel and new cartography, linked the world's oceans — da Gama to India, Columbus to the Americas, Magellan's fleet around the globe — beginning European maritime empire.
